    def setStudent(self, aStudent):
        if not self._canSetStudent:
            return False
        if aStudent is None:
            return False
        existingStudent = self._student
        self._student = aStudent
        index = -1
        if existingStudent is not None and existingStudent is not aStudent:
            index = existingStudent.indexOfRegistration(self)
            existingStudent.removeRegistration(self)
        if not self._student.addRegistration(self):
            self._student = existingStudent
            if index >= 0 and existingStudent.indexOfRegistration(self) < 0:
                existingStudent._registrations.insert(index, self)
            return False
        return True

    def setCourseSection(self, aCourseSection):
        if not self._canSetCourseSection:
            return False
        if aCourseSection is None:
            return False
        existingCourseSection = self._courseSection
        self._courseSection = aCourseSection
        index = -1
        if existingCourseSection is not None and existingCourseSection is not aCourseSection:
            index = existingCourseSection.indexOfRegistration(self)
            existingCourseSection.removeRegistration(self)
        if not self._courseSection.addRegistration(self):
            self._courseSection = existingCourseSection
            if index >= 0 and existingCourseSection.indexOfRegistration(self) < 0:
                existingCourseSection._registrations.insert(index, self)
            return False
        return True

    def __eq__(self, obj):
        if type(obj) is not type(self):
            return NotImplemented
        return (self.getStudent(), self.getCourseSection()) == (obj.getStudent(), obj.getCourseSection())

    def __hash__(self):
        if self._cachedHashCode is None:
            self._cachedHashCode = hash((self.getStudent(), self.getCourseSection()))
            self._canSetStudent = False
            self._canSetCourseSection = False
        return self._cachedHashCode

    def equals(self, obj):
        return self == obj
